RESEARCH.md.inserted_paragraph: **Aggregation changes the sorting relation, 8 October 2026.** [The empirical continuation](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AGGREGATION-SELECTION-INTEGRATION.md) preserves eight original source files and reconstructs 54 video means in 18 technical replicates. K. lactis speeds rise from 3.6058 to 16.3423 mm/min across density treatments, while the S. cerevisiae contrast is smaller and sensitive to technical-replicate deletion. A separate original-XML/rational implementation checks 132 numerical values. The primary source also reports unicell transport benefits and repeated-transfer coexistence; these remain reported results, not newly reconstructed population histories. The theory now distinguishes inherited clusters, temporary sorting aggregates and viable descendants, crediting the conventional ecological explanation. **Next:** joint attachment, aggregate membership, sampled viable representation and redevelopment records; full comparative strength and renewal remain open. / **聚合与筛选：** 明确保留技术重复层级，临时共同运输不等于新的遗传个体；本轮无新定理或独立生物重复。

theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-exis.inserted_paragraph: **Developed association → mixture-dependent continuation, 8 October 2026.** [The aggregation continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/AGGREGATION-SELECTION-INTEGRATION.md) reconstructs 54 video means and preserves their 18 technical-replicate groups. A primary experiment connects inherited clusters, temporary aggregation, shared sorting benefits and repeated-transfer coexistence. The derivation must distinguish developmental inheritance, transported associations and viable descendants while tracing their actual relations. This constrains the next composition and strengthens the conventional comparator; it does not supply broad predictive superiority, a complete lineage/support history or normative warrant.

sources/SOURCES.md.inserted_paragraph: **Measured aggregation and coexistence, 8 October 2026.** [Driscoll & Travisano 2017](evolutionary-selection/driscoll-2017/README.md) now has unchanged original article XML, publisher HTML and six supplementary workbooks, with URL/byte/SHA-256 provenance.
